svg.aria-label: British Virgin Islands real island coastlines, neighbouring United States Virgin Islands and nine locations
svg.metadata: Target land: GSHHG/GSHHS full-resolution shoreline via Basemap 2.0.0 (Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith; https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/wessel/gshhg/), assigned with Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 map subunits ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19 (public domain) unit VGB (British Virgin Islands); internal land boundaries follow Natural Earth. Surrounding land: the same GSHHG shoreline, drawn to the canvas edge. WGS84; local-equirectangular-fit-v1, 1200x760. The U.S. Virgin Islands are context only.
